chapters.label: Live: third place, 2004
chapters.text: Taipei, 2004, the Futsal World Cup, the match for third place. Pivot Vander Carioca wears number fourteen. At half-time, Brazil lead Argentina six to one. Final whistle: seven to four! Brazil win bronze.

chapters.label: The move on his card
chapters.text: This is the move on his card: the lay-off. Watch it slowly. His back is to goal. The pass comes in. He holds off the defender. One touch sets it back. His teammate shoots. Goal!

chapters.label: Let the ball work
chapters.text: Let the ball do the work! A pass beats any runner, and saves your legs. Vander played until he was forty-two.
